summary: Axial Shift was founded in 2017 in Austin, TX by Justin Buckley (CEO/President) and Matt Woodings (CTO), both former HotSchedules executives, with Ellis Winstanley (a former multi-unit restaurant operator) as Executive Chairman.
Axial Shift raised $4 million in seed funding from Silverton Partners.

Axial Shift is a real-time frontline performance and gamification platform integrating with POS systems to provide dashboards, contests, and AI-driven forecasting aimed at sales-per-labor-hour and labor-target execution.
